summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing repurchases of 935,500 ordinary shares under its pre-existing $500 million buyback program. Shares were acquired in three tranches on May 22, May 29, and June 5, 2026, at prices ranging from $10.75 to $11.59 per share, for an aggregate cost of $10,483,880.54. The repurchased shares will be held in treasury. No board recommendation or advisor was named, as this is a routine open-market buyback execution. The filing relates to a foreign private issuer's capital return program; no shareholder vote or tender offer was involved. The buyback reduces outstanding share count and supports earnings per share. Watch for future repurchase activity and any program updates or suspensions.
